# usgs

## Provider

US Geological Survey

## Product

Modern continuous water-data API; discharge parameter 00060

## Coverage

One supported USGS station per request

## Resolution

Point station; native observation intervals

## Temporal coverage

Provider-available observations; <=31-day requests

## Access method

Modern OGC JSON API, cursor pagination, seven-day batches

## What it provides

Observed discharge at an identified streamgage through time.

## Available CubeDynamics nouns

[streamflow](../nouns/streamflow.md)

## Current QA/certification status

Bounded real acquisition and offline checks passed for retained samples. Broader scientific review and sustained-load testing remain open; endpoint availability is independent. QA profile: `station_timeseries`. [Evidence and scope](../../data/source_projects/production.md).

## Serving revision / provenance information

Rolling values/status; stable key is series ID plus time. No production serving revision assigned. Raw response hashes, request parameters, and source-specific metadata are preserved; a live refresh never overwrites an existing snapshot.

## Important limitations

10,000 observations; 40 requests / 16 MB bodies / 180 s. Preserve native units/statistic and provisional flags; missing values are not filled. Multiple series require explicit selection. No synthetic fallback.

[USGS Water Data APIs](https://api.waterdata.usgs.gov/)
